--- PART 1/3 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The general advice says begin cooperatively, avoid permanent retaliation, etc. It doesn't mention exploiting. But objective is maximize score."
STRATEGY: Parent slot 8 is a conditional cooperator that mostly cooperates with cooperative opponents and defects against defectors. The trace simulates iterated PD payoffs and opponent types (AllC, AllD, TFT, random, forgiving) to design an improved strategy. It changes the strategy to start C, test with a D, then exploit non-retaliators while cooperating with retaliators.

--- PART 2/3 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The general advice says begin cooperatively. So start C."
STRATEGY: Parent is a tournament strategy revised toward cooperation/forgiveness; simulated against TFT, AllC, AllD, forgiving triggers, and random; changed to start C, test with D at round 1, apologize with C at round 2, then use lagged exploit/retaliation counts and forgiveness rules.

--- PART 3/3 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The general advice strongly encourages cooperation." / "The general advice emphasizes cooperation, suggesting that the tournament rewards cooperation."
STRATEGY: Parent starts C, cooperates unless provoked, forgives after retaliation, and defects near the end. The trace simulates the parent against the proposed strategy and against TFT, AllC, AllD, and Grim Trigger. It changes the strategy to test with D at round 1, apologize with C at round 2, forgive provoked defections when opponent defection rate is below 80%, exploit opponents that never defect, and defect on the last round.
